svg.title: MOMO R166 — REQ146 SOFT ENGINEERING
svg.desc: Unified monochrome print artwork informed by control association and graphic hierarchy in Make Noise panel references, with gentler curves and open space. Existing 14HP panel, seven R166 paths, apertures, small soft-butterfly MIC, enlarged buttons, approved STILL fan, MIX collar, status LEDs, wordmark and official bottom lockup are retained. Cat redrawn separately from the user pet photographs. Editable visual artwork, not a manufacturing release.

defs.metadata: Visual review only. R166 centre-lines are optical artwork, not seven aluminium slots. Final module mark is deliberately not selected in this base.
Visual review only. R166 centre-lines are optical artwork, not seven aluminium slots. The upper-right module-mark slot remains deliberately empty until a standalone mark passes.
INTERNAL REVIEW ONLY. The phase-selvage mark is a MOMO module mark, not the Rymovia brand mark. R166 centre-lines remain optical artwork, not seven aluminium slots.

INTERNAL REVIEW ONLY. Seven R166 centre-lines, mechanical apertures, lower layout and official Rymovia lockup are frozen. The two dark paths are uninterrupted print-preview styling on unchanged R166 geometry, not new LED paths or production slots.

INTERNAL REVIEW ONLY. REQ-122: classic butterfly Lissajous MIC; larger lower manual controls; continuous electronic-engineering ornament system. A7 keeps the approved R166 motherform and proposes a restrained signal-state grammar. R2 hidden layers are coupon communication geometry, not closed CNC, optical, or Gerber production files.
